p1.original: 9.1 动机是行为表现的内在倾向，容易受到内部和外部因素的影响。
p1.en: 9.1 Motivation is an inherent tendency to behave and is vulnerable to internal and external factors.

p2.original: 9.2 一些长期存在的问题因一个结合了马斯洛需要层次理论与进化心理学的新理论的出现而得以解决，该理论认为功能、近因和发展因素决定了我们动机的优先级。
p2.en: 9.2 Some of the long-standing problems are addressed by the emergence of a new theory combining the need for a hierarchy of theory and evolutionary psychology in Maslow, which considers that functional, proximate and developmental factors determine the priority of our motives.

p3.original: 9.3 尽管饥饿和性在许多方面迥然不同，却都源于进化，而且都是生理和社会需要相结合的产物，但只有一种需要是个体生存所必需的。
p3.en: 9.3 Although hunger and sexuality differ in many respects, they are both a product of evolution and a combination of biological and social needs, only one need is necessary for individual survival.

p4.original: 9.4 情绪是一种特殊的动机，能帮助我们关注和应对重要（通常是外部）的情况，并与他人交流我们的意图。
p4.en: 9.4 Emotion is a particular motivation that helps us to focus on and respond to important (usually external) situations and to share our intentions with others.

p5.original: 9.5 大脑中有两种情绪处理系统：一种是有意识的，另一种是无意识的。这个发现为一些关于情绪与认知的早期争论提供了新的思路。
p5.en: 9.5 There are two emotional treatment systems in the brain: conscious and unconscious. This discovery has provided new ideas for some early debates about emotions and perceptions.

p6.original: 大多数成功案例都离不开战胜绝望和逆境的过程，马库斯·马里奥塔（Marcus Mariota）也不例外。他在读高中时曾是一名出色的运动员，却活在一个被教练看来更有才华的四分卫的阴影下，在替补位置上苦苦地挣扎了三年。他的妈妈回忆说，马库斯曾多次在比赛结束后回家的路上，几乎要哭出来。在读高中的最后一年，马库斯终于获准参赛，带领圣路易斯高中足球队夺得夏威夷州冠军。后来他成为俄勒冈大学一名出色的四分卫，但是他在读大学时橄榄球方面的成功，以及后来被选为职业球员，期间都充满着不定与变数。
p6.en: Most success stories are dependent on the process of overcoming despair and adversity, and Marcus Mariota is no exception. He was an outstanding athlete in high school, but lived three years of bitter struggle in a substitute position under the shadow of a quarterback that the coach seemed more talented. His mother recalled that Marcus had been on his way home many times after the game, almost crying. In the last year of high school, Marcus was finally allowed to play, leading the St. Louis High School football team to the Hawaiian state championship. He later became an excellent quarterback at the University of Oregon, but his success in football at the university and his subsequent election as a professional player was fraught with uncertainty and variability.

p7.original: “确实很艰难，”他回忆道，“但我从中汲取教训，变得愈发坚强。”（Chapman，2012）
p7.en: “It was hard,” he said, “But I learned from it and became stronger. @Chapman 2012

p8.original: 学习是他的第一个障碍。在上小学时，因阅读能力太差，一位老师曾想将他拒之门外。父母发现马库斯不知道字母的发音，便让他把车牌上的字母读出来。结果见效了（Chapman，2012；Rohan，2014）。
p8.en: Learning is his first obstacle. At the time of primary school, a teacher had tried to keep him out of school because of his poor reading skills. When they found out that Marcus did not know the letter, they asked him to read out the letter on the licence plate. Results (Chapman, 2012); Rohan, 2014.

p9.original: 马库斯开始在圣路易斯高中既以学生身份又以运动员身份崭露头角。后来，在俄勒冈大学，他经常拿到20个学分，在橄榄球赛季也不例外。最终，在不到四年的时间里他获得了理学学位，平均成绩B+，这对于一个差点要留级的孩子来说已经很不错了。
p9.en: Marcus began to show up as both a student and an athlete at St. Louis High School. Later, at the University of Oregon, he regularly received 20 credits, including during the football season. Eventually, he obtained a degree in science in less than four years, with an average B+, which was already good for a child who almost had to repeat.

p10.original: 我们不能将马库斯的全部成就都归功于他的父母和老师。马库斯的内在特质也助他渡过了难关，他总是有明确的目标。四年级时，在老师布置的一篇畅想未来的作文中，他就明确了高中参加橄榄球比赛，之后进入南加利福尼亚州大学，再加入美国橄榄球联盟的目标（Chapman，2012）。与他的预期相反，他没能进入南加利福尼亚州大学，南加利福尼亚州大学“特洛伊人队”没有向他提供奖学金。但是，俄勒冈大学“鸭队”的教练看到了他的潜力，并录用了他。马里奥塔以131次达阵得分给予回报，赢得了35场胜利，并获得参加全美季后赛的资格。哦，他还为俄勒冈球员和夏威夷州赢得了有史以来的第一个海斯曼奖杯。这些成就使他在第一轮就被田纳西巨神队选中。
p10.en: We cannot attribute all of Marcus' achievements to his parents and teachers. Marcus' inner traits helped him to get through this, and he always had a clear objective. In the fourth grade, in an essay by the teacher on the future, he identified high school football matches and then entered the University of South California and joined the American Football League (Chapman, 2012). Contrary to his expectations, he was unable to enter the University of South California, and the University of South California, the Trojans, did not offer him a scholarship. But the coach of the Ducks Team at Oregon University saw his potential and hired him. Mariotta paid off with 131 touchdowns, won 35 victories and was eligible to participate in the All-American Post-season tournament. Oh, he won the first Heisman trophy ever for Oregon and Hawaii. These achievements led to his selection in the first round by the Tennessee Giant.

p11.original: 马库斯以多种领导特质的奇特组合完成了这一切：不难预测，他极具竞争精神，即使在紧急的情况下也能泰然自若。但矛盾的是，他说话温和、谦逊，甚至有点害羞。马库斯深受队友的喜爱，他似乎更多的是以身作则，而不像常见的球队领导者那样，用响亮的“喝彩”来鼓舞士气。这些特质融合在一起会使马库斯难以被“解读”，但事实证明，这对四分卫来说是一个优势。“我（父母）是唯一真正能读懂我肢体语言的人。”他说（Fentress，2012）。
p11.en: Marcus did all of this with a strange combination of leadership qualities: no doubt, he was extremely competitive, and even in emergency situations, he could be very comfortable. Paradoxically, he spoke softly, modestly and even shyly. Marcus is very much loved by his teammates, who seem to be more by example than the usual team leaders, who inspire morale with loud “hots”. The combination of these features makes it difficult for Marcus to “read”, but it has proved to be an advantage for the quarterback. "I am the only person who can really read my body language. He said (Fentress, 2012).

p12.original: 但是这些特征主要是外显的和行为方面的，而动机与情绪（本章的主题）还涉及内部需要、驱力和感觉。那么，什么样的内在心理机制使马库斯具有强烈的竞争精神？或许长时间的训练和对比赛的研究，抑制了他的情绪表达？当然，我们不能直接观察到他的动机，但是我们可以推测，这些动机是先天与后天，即遗传与经验的结合。
p12.en: However, these characteristics are mainly outward and behavioural, while motivations and emotions (the subject of this chapter) also relate to internal needs, driving forces and feelings. So, what kind of mental mechanism is inherent in giving Marcus a strong spirit of competition? Maybe long training and research on the competition has inhibited his emotional expression? Of course, we cannot observe his motives directly, but we can assume that they are a combination of birth and birth, that is, genetic and empirical.

p13.original: 马库斯本人将自己的行为举止归因于经验，他说他的父母教导他要谦逊和矜持。他的母亲则强调先天因素，说：“他一直都是这样，所见即所得。”（Chapman，2012）不过，正如他的姨妈所说：“只有在家人身边时，他才直言不讳。”（Chen，2014）
p13.en: Marcus himself attributed his behaviour to experience, saying that his parents had taught him to be humble and to be moderate. His mother, for her part, emphasized the congenital factor and said, “He has always been so, so he sees what he gets. @Chapman, 2012), however, as his aunt said: “He only speaks openly when he is near his family. (Chen, 2014)

p14.original: 显然，波利尼西亚文化也在马库斯·马里奥塔身上留下了印记。正如队友所说，马库斯拥有“夏威夷人的酷”（Chapman，2012）。在接受海斯曼奖时，马库斯说：“在夏威夷，如果一个人成功了，那么整个州就都成功了。作为其中的一员，我感觉很特别。”（Rohan，2014）
p14.en: It is clear that Polynesian culture has also left a mark on Marcus Mariota. As the teammates say, Marcus has the "Hawai cool" (Chapman, 2012). In accepting the Heisman Prize, Marcus said, “In Hawaii, if a man succeeds, then the whole state succeeds. As one of them, I feel very special. #Rohan, 2014

p15.original: 所有这些因素——家庭、朋友、遗传、文化、失望、成功和荣誉，无疑对马库斯的竞争性和保守性不同寻常的结合产生了影响。与往常不同的是，在接受海斯曼奖的获奖感言中，马库斯的情绪爆发了，泪水夺眶而出。“一路走来，一路披荆斩棘，”他这样讲，最后用萨摩亚语对在场的所有人说：“非常感谢！”（Rohan，2014）
p15.en: All of these factors — family, friends, genetics, culture, disappointment, success and honour — undoubtedly have an impact on Marcus's competitive and conservative extraordinary combination. Unlike usual, in the award-winning words of the Heisman Prize, Marcus' emotions burst and tears woke up. “Through the journey, he said to all present in Samoan: “Thank you very much!” #Rohan, 2014

p16.en: This chapter considers the following topics:

p17.original: 动机与情绪理论如何帮助我们了解复杂的人类，像马库斯·马里奥塔、我们的家人和朋友……也许，甚至我们自己？
p17.en: How does motivation and emotional theory help us to understand complex human beings, like Marcus Mariota, our families and friends maybe, even ourselves?
